label: Ponder 32M
desc: Learned by studying tens of millions of positions analysed by Stockfish. No reinforcement learning.

label: Ponder 32M · RL
desc: The 32M model, then trained using reinforcement learning to choose between its own variations and calculations.

label: Ponder 64M
desc: A model twice the size, trained on all 35 million analysed positions and on the lines Stockfish expected to follow. The strongest one.

label: Ponder 64M · RL
desc: The 64M model, then trained with reinforcement learning on its own look-ahead lines and on games against Stockfish. Plays about as well as the plain 64M in our tests.
